audit_type: read-only source audit for Physiological Research Original Article
changes_required: Change article type from Short Communication to Original Article in both languages and cover letter.
Restore the four major Introduction/Methods/Results/Discussion headings, with restrained Methods and Results subheadings. No new data or expanded causal claims required.
Convert author-year citations to bracketed numbers in order of first appearance, and reorder all 17 references accordingly.
Expand author lists for three currently abbreviated references from verified metadata; list all seven authors for Gao and Kalb, first seven plus et al. for the eight-author He paper.
Preserve the native Word formula Q = 2^(-Delta Cq) and subsequent division by the sham arithmetic mean; do not replace the actual calculation with a generic 2^(-Delta Delta Cq) claim.
Retain all existing provenance, timepoint, validation and analgesia limitations.

minimal_optional_wording.recommendation: Use expected amplicon lengths if length verification is not supported by retained gel/sequencing records. Current source says lengths without asserting experimental verification; avoid introducing validated lengths.
An optional explicit sentence may state that consistent processing cannot exclude matrix-dependent bias. Do not assert same-batch processing unless batch records support it.
Do not add a blanket ARRIVE-compliance or omission-of-analgesia approval claim. Approval number and absent written rationale/specific opinion are correctly distinguished in the current source.

ROS.assessment: Accurate: fresh-serum intended use, tissue/RIPA use without available validation, fluorescence reader unknown, protein-concentration normalized AU, no species or absolute ROS inference. No assertion that all samples were processed in one batch or error cancelled.

qPCR.assessment: Accurate: n=6 independent rats, animal-paired target/reference, one measurement each, efficiency/reference stability unvalidated, original curves unavailable, NTC/no-RT records unavailable; no single-peak or confirmed specificity assertion.

timepoints.assessment: Accurate: sham/model day 28, restoration day 56; no time-matched second-surgery sham; restoration contrasts descriptive, not reversal or treatment causality.

analgesia.assessment: Accurate: no postoperative analgesics, no retained written rationale/specific ethics opinion, pain/stress as possible confounding; no assertion ethics committee waived analgesia or animals had no pain.
